title: Second Marine squadmate reaches out via LinkedIn

tellings.quote: Keep the faith. there is nothing, no borders lines that they won't cross.

plain: In 2024 a second man from Michael Herrera's old Marine unit reached out to him through LinkedIn, the professional networking site, according to Herrera, a former Marine who says he saw a 300-foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle. Herrera shares their messages, in which the squadmate writes: "Keep the faith. there is nothing, no borders lines that they won't cross." For Herrera, the contact supports his account and warns of how far those hiding it will go.
